jobs.title: Certified Peer Support Specialist – Independent Contractor (1099)
jobs.description:
Certified Peer Support Specialist – Independent Contractor (1099\)Virtual Federal Community Reentry Program

**One Stop Wellness MD / Tele by One Stop**  
**Remote – United States**  
**Engagement Type:** Independent Contractor (1099\)  
**Project Term:** Initial Approximately 3\-Month Federal Contract  
**Assignments:** Based on Participant Referrals and Program Needs  
**Compensation:** Contractor compensation based on agreed service assignments/caseload

Opportunity Overview

One Stop Wellness MD / Tele by One Stop is seeking experienced **Certified Peer Support Specialists** interested in providing virtual peer\-support services as independent contractors for an anticipated nationwide federal Community Reentry Peer Support Services program.

The program supports individuals under Federal Bureau of Prisons jurisdiction who are transitioning into or currently residing within community settings.

Participants may include individuals residing in Residential Reentry Centers, participating in home confinement, assigned to Day Reporting Centers, participating in Federal Location Monitoring, or otherwise receiving authorized community\-reentry services.

This is a **short\-term independent\-contractor opportunity associated with an initial federal contract period expected to last approximately three months**.

Assignments and continuation are dependent upon federal contract requirements, participant referrals, authorized service levels, contractor availability, satisfactory performance, and required federal personnel approval.

There is no guarantee of a specific number of participants, assignments, hours, or continuation beyond the initial project.

Nature of Services

Certified Peer Support Specialists provide **non\-clinical, recovery\-oriented peer support**.

Peer support is based on appropriate lived experience, mutuality, hope, empowerment, participant choice, recovery, goal development, community connection, and successful reintegration.

Peer Support Specialists do not provide psychotherapy, medical treatment, diagnosis, or legal advice while functioning in this role.

Required Certification

Applicants MUST currently possess a qualifying peer\-support credential.

Potential qualifying credentials include:

* National Certified Peer Recovery Support Specialist (NCPRSS)
* National Certified Peer Specialist (NCPS)
* State\-Level Certified Peer Support Specialist
* State\-Level Certified Recovery Specialist
* Other qualifying state\-level certification meeting federal contract requirements

Applicants must provide documentation verifying their certification.

**Uncertified peer trainees cannot provide services under this program.**

Required Qualifications

Applicants should have:

* High school diploma, GED, or higher
* Current qualifying peer\-support certification
* Appropriate lived experience relevant to peer support
* Demonstrated direct peer\-support experience
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Strong documentation skills
* Ability to establish appropriate peer relationships
* Ability to maintain strict professional boundaries
* Ability to maintain participant confidentiality
* Ability to work independently
* Ability to provide remote services professionally
* Ability to recognize circumstances requiring supervisory or emergency escalation
* Ability to complete required documentation accurately and timely
* Ability to work respectfully with justice\-involved individuals

Candidates should be prepared to verify required peer\-support experience. Applicants with **2,000\+ hours of direct peer\-support experience** are strongly encouraged to apply.

Preferred Experience

We are especially interested in Certified Peer Support Specialists with experience involving:

* Community reentry
* Criminal justice involvement
* Correctional populations
* Residential Reentry Centers
* Probation/parole populations
* Substance use recovery
* Mental health recovery
* Co\-occurring disorders
* Virtual peer\-support services
* Veterans
* Housing instability
* Employment/reentry assistance
* Community\-resource navigation

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a passionate and dedicated Certified Peer Support Specialist to serve as an Independent Contractor (1099\). In this vital role, you will leverage your lived experience and professional training to empower individuals navigating mental health challenges, substance use disorders, and co\-occurring conditions. Your energetic and compassionate approach will foster hope, resilience, and recovery within diverse communities. As a key member of our team, you will provide peer\-led support, crisis intervention, and advocacy to promote recovery and well\-being. This position offers flexibility and the opportunity to make a meaningful difference in people's lives through authentic connection and expert guidance.

**Duties**

* Provide peer support by sharing personal recovery experiences, fostering hope, and encouraging clients’ self\-advocacy.
* Engage in crisis management and intervention to de\-escalate situations and connect individuals with appropriate resources.
* Deliver behavioral health and mental health counseling using motivational interviewing techniques to motivate positive change.
* Assist clients with harm reduction strategies and addiction counseling tailored to individual needs.
* Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams using electronic health record (EHR) systems to document progress, care plans, and interventions accurately.
* Work with culturally diverse communities to ensure respectful, inclusive support that honors individual backgrounds and experiences.
* Mentor clients through recovery journeys, emphasizing peer support advocacy and client communication skills while maintaining strict confidentiality.

jobs.title: Certified Peer Support Specialist – Virtual / Nationwide Federal Reentry Program
jobs.description:
One Stop Wellness MD / Tele by One Stop is seeking an experienced **Certified Peer Support Specialist to serve as Lead Peer Support Supervisor** for an anticipated nationwide virtual Community Reentry Peer Support Services program supporting individuals under Federal Bureau of Prisons (FBOP) jurisdiction who are transitioning into community settings.

This is a **temporary, part\-time W\-2 position** associated with an initial federal contract period expected to last approximately three months. Continuation beyond the initial period is not guaranteed and will depend on federal contract continuation or option periods, program volume, performance, and organizational needs.

The Lead Peer Support Supervisor will combine direct peer\-support expertise with program supervision, documentation oversight, staff development, compliance monitoring, and continuity\-of\-service responsibilities.

This is a **non\-clinical peer\-support position**. The role does not provide psychotherapy, medical treatment, diagnosis, or legal advice.Job Summary  
Join a dynamic nationwide federal reentry program as a Certified Peer Support Specialist, providing vital virtual support to individuals navigating the challenges of reentry after incarceration. In this role, you will leverage your lived experience and professional training to empower clients on their recovery journey, promote mental health stability, and foster community reintegration. This paid position offers an exciting opportunity to make a meaningful impact across diverse communities by delivering compassionate, culturally sensitive peer support through virtual platforms. Your expertise will help clients develop resilience, manage crises, and access essential behavioral health resources in a supportive and confidential environment.

Duties

* Provide peer support and mentorship to individuals with criminal justice involvement, focusing on recovery, mental health, and substance use issues.
* Utilize motivational interviewing techniques and harm reduction strategies to encourage positive behavioral change.
* Share personal recovery experiences to inspire hope and foster trust with clients from diverse backgrounds.
* Conduct crisis management and intervention when clients experience mental health or behavioral emergencies, ensuring safety and appropriate referrals.
* Maintain strict confidentiality of client information while documenting interactions accurately within electronic health record (EHR) systems.
* Collaborate with behavioral health professionals and social service providers to coordinate care plans tailored to each client’s needs.
* Engage in ongoing training related to cultural competence, co\-occurring disorders, addiction counseling, and peer support advocacy to enhance service quality.

Skills

* Strong crisis management and crisis intervention skills to respond effectively during emergencies.
* Deep understanding of behavioral health, mental health counseling, addiction counseling, and recovery peer support principles.
* Experience working with individuals with substance use disorders and co\-occurring mental health conditions.
* Ability to work effectively with culturally diverse communities while demonstrating cultural sensitivity and respect.
* Excellent client communication skills, including sharing personal recovery stories to motivate clients.
* Proficiency in using electronic health record (EHR) systems for documentation and case management.
* Knowledge of harm reduction strategies, motivational interviewing techniques, and social work practices.

This role is ideal for compassionate professionals committed to empowering individuals through peer support advocacy in a flexible virtual environment. If you are energized by helping others rebuild their lives and possess the necessary skills, we invite you to join our mission\-driven team dedicated to fostering hope, resilience, and successful reentry outcomes nationwide!

Why Consider This Opportunity?

This role offers an experienced peer\-support professional the opportunity to:

* Work remotely
* Participate in a nationwide federal community\-reentry initiative
* Develop federal\-contract and reentry\-program experience
* Serve in a leadership/supervisory capacity
* Support Certified Peer Support Specialists across multiple geographic areas
* Maintain a flexible part\-time schedule based on program needs
* Perform meaningful work supporting individuals transitioning back into their communities
* Potentially continue with the program if federal option periods or additional opportunities become available

Required program training will be paid for W\-2 employees.

Required Certification

Applicants must hold a current qualifying peer\-support certification issued by an appropriate state\-specific board/agency or recognized national organization.

Potential qualifying credentials include:

* National Certified Peer Recovery Support Specialist (NCPRSS)
* National Certified Peer Specialist (NCPS)
* State\-Level Certified Peer Support Specialist
* State\-Level Certified Recovery Specialist
* Other qualifying state\-specific peer\-support certification meeting federal contract requirements

**Uncertified peer trainees do not qualify for direct service under this federal program.**

Minimum Qualifications

Candidates must meet applicable federal contract and credential requirements and should possess:

* High school diploma, GED, or higher
* Current qualifying peer\-support certification
* Appropriate lived experience relevant to peer\-support work
* Strong direct peer\-support experience
* Ability to provide verification of required education, training, experience, and credentials
* Strong written documentation skills
* Excellent professional communication skills
* Demonstrated ability to maintain professional boundaries
* Ability to supervise and mentor Peer Support Specialists
* Strong organizational and quality\-assurance skills
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment
